chunks: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) fasted on the day of 'Ashura.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast on the day of Ashura?
ai.summary: This narration from al-istibsar confirms the Prophet’s voluntary fasting on the tenth of Muharram, a practice he adopted after observing the Jews of Medina honoring the day as a day of deliverance. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the virtue of 'Ashura fasting as a confirmed Sunnah (mustahabb), distinct from the later commemoration of Imam Husayn’s martyrdom, serving as a spiritual preparation for the month of Muharram.
